rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Gardharus 
"All I ask is a small amount of funding for my...ah...research when this war is won. Wait...I haven't finished. There is a relic locked away here; something that predates the concept of war. It has grown powerful as time has passed."

Gardharus
